tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description:
Add, change, move and delete files with one patch. Format:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: path
+each line of the new file
*** Update File: path
*** Move to: new/path (optional)
@@ optional line to find first
 context line
-removed line
+added line
*** Delete File: path
*** End Patch
Give about three lines of context around each change; hunks apply in file order. Every file is checked before any is written, so a patch that does not apply changes nothing.

patch.description: The whole patch, from *** Begin Patch to *** End Patch.
